description.en: Herrerasaurus ischigualastensis has a deep hip region, strong grasping hands, relatively compact neck and elongate toothed skull. Skin, colour and soft tissues are inferred from a mounted skeleton that may contain restored parts, not calibrated individual anatomy.
description.zh: 埃雷拉龙 Herrerasaurus ischigualastensis 具有厚实髋部、强壮抓握手、相对紧凑的颈部和带齿长头骨。皮肤、颜色与软组织参照可能含修补部分的装架骨架推断，并非经校准的个体解剖复原。

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block deep pelvis, strong grasping hands and a relatively compact neck with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织较深骨盆、有力抓握手与相对紧凑的颈部；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: deep pelvis, strong grasping hands and a relatively compact neck. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：较深骨盆、有力抓握手与相对紧凑的颈部。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Balanced biped, deep hip/pelvic body visible, modestly flexed compact neck, strong hands extended slightly ahead and clear of torso, palms inward; tail off ground.

scale.basis: 3m approximate NHM profile; width/height artistic estimates, not specimen measurements.

scientific_limits.en: Skin, color and soft tissues are inferred. Mounted skeleton may contain restored parts; photographic perspective is not calibrated anatomy. Taxonomic placement beyond named herrerasaurid is not settled here.
scientific_limits.zh: 皮肤、颜色和软组织为推断；展示骨架可能含修补，透视照片不是校准测量。本件不裁定该类更细系统位置。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original living reconstruction of Herrerasaurus ischigualastensis guided by Field Museum mounted skeleton photograph; not an exact catalogue specimen scan.
shape_requirements: Preserve deep pelvis, strong grasping hands and relatively compact neck together; no Coelophysis long-neck slender-hand substitution.
Deep hip mass and substantial hindlimbs with readable hip/knee/ankle joints; tail smoothly tapers as counterbalance.
Grasping hands are a visible feature, not tiny tyrannosaur stubs. Three prominent clawed fingers plus reduced outer digits interpreted cautiously; no human-pronated palms.
Elongate toothed skull with moderate muzzle, not a bulky tyrannosaur head; living surface must cover bony fenestrae.
Profile/loft torso, neck and thighs; deliberate negative spaces; no untouched primitive chain.

description.en: This genus-level Psittacosaurus has a short deep beak, cheek projections and a localized tail-bristle region. The reference fossil is not securely assigned to a species; body thickness, colour and complete bristle lengths remain estimates.
description.zh: 此属级鹦鹉嘴龙 Psittacosaurus 具有短而深的喙、颊部突起和尾部局部鬃毛区。参考化石不能可靠归入具体种；体厚、颜色及鬃毛完整长度仍为估计。

construction_notes: Use a restrained set of bristle bundles as low-poly simplification; no exact91-bristle replication requirement or sharp porcupine spines.
Do not confuse fossil crushing or missing bristle tips with living anatomy. Mildly rounded/blunt bristle ends are acceptable.
Neutral brown palette with restrained light belly is artistic, not a precise measured pigmentation map.
Original gate is checked in front/side/oblique gray views before detail; no extra pose or fine-skin map gate.

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic envelope, not measured SMF R4970; NHM2m is general genus context only.

frozen_scientific_scope.final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
frozen_scientific_scope.gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
frozen_scientific_scope.material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block short deep beak, cheek projections and bristled tail region with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织短深喙、颊部突起与尾部鬃状区；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: short deep beak, cheek projections and bristled tail region. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：短深喙、颊部突起与尾部鬃状区。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

scientific_limits.en: SMF R4970 is crushed and not securely assigned to a species. Skull breadth, restored beak and cheek proportions, complete bristle tips, body thickness, color and pose are estimates. Tail bristles are directly evidenced, but their exact original count and full lengths are not reconstructed here. No species-specific pattern or sex is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: SMF R4970受压扁且无法可靠归入具体种。头骨宽度、复原喙与颊部比例、完整鬃端、体厚、颜色及姿态均为估值。尾鬃有直接证据，但本模型不复刻其原始精确数量和完整长度。不主张特定种的花纹或性别。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original genus-level Psittacosaurus living reconstruction anchored to bristle-bearing SMF R4970. Species deliberately left indeterminate, following primary study rather than falsely naming the specimen P.mongoliensis.
shape_requirements: Original short deep beak, lateral cheek projections and bristled tail region must be visible together.
Compact deep skull with paired modest jugal projections, not large neck frill or long Triceratops face horns.
Tail has a localized dorsal bristle zone of individually legible slender rods, not a full feather fan, sail or uniform spikes over entire back.
Compact trunk, stronger hindlimbs and short forelimbs, long tapering tail; maintain head and limb gaps.
frozen_scientific_scope.taxon_scope: Psittacosaurus sp., SMF R4970; not asserted to be P.mongoliensis or P.lujiatunensis

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Length follows plate caption; width and height are artistic estimates.

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly direction: establish inflated spherical glabella and extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以球形膨大头鞍配极度缩窄的多刺躯干搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。

shape_gate.en: Its distinguishing construction is inflated spherical glabella and extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk; retain this geometry rather than treating it as a recolor, scale or pose variant.
shape_gate.zh: 以球形膨大头鞍配极度缩窄的多刺躯干为独立造型依据；须保留这些结构差异，不能仅靠换色、缩放或姿势区别。

scientific_limits.en: Ventral limbs, antennae, color, posture and body thickness are inferred, not preserved in the consulted dorsal photograph. The 3.5 cm plate caption anchors approximate length, not an exact reconstructed individual. No buoyancy or feeding behavior is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 腹面肢、触角、颜色、姿态与体厚为推断，并非所查背面照片保存的信息。图版所标3.5厘米仅作为近似长度依据，不是精确个体复原。不主张其浮力机制或摄食行为。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original living stylization of Deiphon barrandei guided by actual fossil photograph, not a specimen replica.
shape_requirements: Preserve original spherical inflated glabella plus extremely reduced narrow spiny trunk.
Large bulbous glabella dominates anterior profile; narrow segmented axial body and separate swept pleural spines, not a broad solid oval shell.
Paired long curved genal spines and paired rear pointed extensions follow dorsal fossil silhouette.
Small lateral eyes remain subordinate; inferred ventral appendages must not obscure dorsal spaces.

description.en: Fossil-informed Aegirocassis with two flap tiers and paired filtering appendages using the revised six-long-endite interpretation. Eyes, soft tissues, colour, pose and exact proportions are reconstructed; filtering setae are reduced and thickened, not a true mesh-size model. No tail fan is added.
description.zh: 依据化石复原的 Aegirocassis，保留双层侧叶及成对滤食附肢，采用六条长内叶的新解释。眼、软组织、颜色、姿态与精确比例属推定；滤食刚毛减少并加粗，不代表真实滤网孔径，不添加尾扇。

frozen_scientific_scope.budget_rationale: Allow the two flap tiers, tripartite shell and open paired filters to remain distinct. Aim for 6500–9500 triangles; spend on silhouette and sparse closed filter bristles rather than microscopic spinules. Caps are practical task budgets, not fossil facts.

context.interval: Early Ordovician; late Tremadocian reference material
context.locality: Lower Fezouata Shale, Ternata plain near Zagora, Morocco

design.colour_claim: Entire palette is an original artistic choice; fossil iron staining is not living pigmentation.
design.pose: Near-symmetric level swimming and active filtering; mild natural flap cant, no exaggerated attack curl. No stand, substrate, water effects, text or labels in the exported geometry.
design.style: Deliberate lofts and shaped fins, not a stack of untouched spheres or cones. Keep large shell, short broad trunk and hanging filter basket readable at thumbnail scale.
design.surface: Controlled facets on large shell/loft forms with clean edge changes; smooth or mixed normals on slender filtering structures. Matte portable PBR materials, no transparency-dependent net sheets.

dimensions.scale_note: Representative large animal within the reported greater-than-2 m size class, not a measured single individual. Do not unit-normalize.

frozen_scientific_scope.frozen_scope: Preparation-only freeze for a local fixed candidate. Maker, technical evidence, independent QA, GPU, scene, user and publication states must each be established separately.

morphology_requirements.requirement: Tripartite cephalic carapace: one long pointed, low-convex central shield with an axial keel and rounded broad rear, plus two separate oval lateral elements. Central shield approximately as long as the exposed trunk; it projects forward, not backward over half the trunk. Include modest downturned posterolateral extensions; do not make a helmet dome or bivalve enclosing the animal.

Broad low trunk, slight maximum width near segment 3, then taper to a short blunt segment 11. Preserve 11 discernible segments, with shallow intersegmental recesses. Ten flap-bearing segments; terminal 11th has no added flap pair.

On each of the first ten segments, retain distinct left/right dorsal AND ventral flaps: 20 dorsal plus 20 ventral. Dorsal fins are shorter, pointed and recurved; lower triangular paddles are longer with rounded tips. Separate their root heights and keep successive flaps non-overlapping in neutral pose. They must not read as a single scalloped ribbon.

Indicate transverse bands of setal blades across the back connected near dorsal flap bases, with blades running fore-aft. Simplify as low longitudinal ridges across each dorsal band. Do not mistake these bands for an extra row of fins.

Two frontal appendages beneath the head, each a short articulated upper shaft supporting one shorter proximal comb endite plus six long inward-curved blade-like endites. The first five long endites carry one dense-looking row of thin setae; the sixth has visibly shorter, thicker, curved setae. Preserve a gap and bilateral structure, while inward-canted endites form an open filter basket rather than raptorial claws or six bare rods.

Use representative sparse rows of solid setae with actual air gaps; do not model every biological seta or microspinule and do not claim exact filtering mesh size. Keep first-five versus sixth-endite distinction visible. Distal shaft details are schematic: do not invent a rigidly established extra terminal podomere count.

If included, use two small eyes in posterior gaps between carapace elements, explicitly inferred. Do not add giant anterior eye stalks, a prominent toothed predatory oral cone, walking legs, antennae, a tail fan or tail streamers. A subdued ventral mouth recess may be used only as an acknowledged reconstruction.

scientific_limits.en: Body layout and filtering structures are fossil-informed; exact proportions, living colour, pose and soft tissues remain reconstructed. Eyes are inferred from comparative anatomy and oral-cone details are not established for this species. Fine filtering spinules are omitted and visible setae are deliberately reduced and thickened, not a true mesh-size model. The 2023 six-endite interpretation supersedes the five-long-endite layout of the 2015 reconstruction; the terminal appendage region remains incompletely known. No tail fan is added.
scientific_limits.zh: 体态和滤食结构依据化石，精确比例、活体颜色、姿态及软组织仍属复原。眼睛位置来自比较解剖推断，本种口锥细节尚未确定。微细小刺省略，可见刚毛减少并加粗，不代表真实滤网孔径。附肢采用2023年六条长内叶的新解释，不照搬2015年五条长内叶复原；末端节区仍不完整可知。不添加尾扇。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static refined-low-poly whole-animal reconstruction of Aegirocassis, informed principally by A. benmoulai from the Early Ordovician Lower Fezouata Shale of Morocco. A representative living animal, not a scan, exact individual replica, or claim of resolved soft anatomy.

taxon.nomenclature_note: Use benmoulai; corrected by Van Roy, Briggs and Gaines in 2015 and retained by Potin et al. in 2023.

views_policy.gray_checks: 3–4 low-cost blockout checks before final polish; private only.
views_policy.preview: May reuse the exact perspective bytes.
views_policy.website_render: No exact website renderer/config has been supplied to this prep. Do not claim website image compliance. Retain standard diagnostic perspective; only generate integration display assets when required by the verified release contract.

visual_acceptance: Front: two separate suspended filtering arrays, open negative space and dorsal/ventral flap height separation; avoid central fused solid grille.
Side: long low forward shield, oval lateral element, hanging curved endites and two distinct flap tiers.
Top: carapace/trunk proportions, 11-part taper, terminal blunt rear without fan, paired rows of separate flaps.
Perspective: all diagnostic features legible together; no accidental collisions, intersecting shell lobes, disconnected bristles or thin-plane disappearance.

description.en: Whole-adult woolly rhinoceros, Coelodonta antiquitatis, combining fossil and permafrost evidence with a substantial oval nasal-horn base. Proportions are approximate, not a cast of one specimen; fur, colour, soft tissue, pose and full horn curvature remain artistic choices.
description.zh: 披毛犀 Coelodonta antiquitatis 成体全身复原，综合化石与冻土材料，鼻角采用厚实椭圆基部。体比例为近似值，非单一标本翻模；毛量、颜色、软组织、姿势与完整角弯度仍属美术选择。

art_direction.construction: Original controlled profile lofts for trunk, cheek, neck and tapered limbs; shaped horn sweeps with ellipse-changing cross sections. Continuous intentional transitions and mixed flat/smooth normals. No untouched sphere/cylinder collage.
art_direction.palette: Muted warm umber body, subdued warm-brown dorsal mane, lighter muzzle/undercoat, charcoal eyes and hooves, warm dark keratin. No speculative stripes or glossy toy finish.
art_direction.target_view: Readable at museum card size, with deliberate medium-range contour detail; no microscopic fidelity claim.
art_direction.texture_policy: No image textures, alpha cards, displacement, particle fur or external bitmap dependencies. Material colors are original design choices, not specimen color claims.

diagnostic_targets: Long heavy trunk and deep chest on short strong legs; raised withers flow into a gently declining back and rounded rump. Avoid a tall elephant-like outline or a hippo body with a pasted-on cone.

Two median keratin horns. The anterior nasal horn is distinctly longer and gently swept backward, with a broad fore-aft oval base, tapering into a compressed distal shaft. The shorter frontal horn is separate and more upright behind it. Both attach to real volumes, never a floating spike.

The main horn base fore-aft-to-transverse ratio is approximately 1.5. Preserve obvious width at attachment and taper; do not flatten the base into a razor blade or copy the broken MM 3074 stump as a whole horn.

An elongated low-carried head with a substantial cheek, tapered neck, blunt muzzle, recessed small lateral eyes and two compact pointed ears set high at the rear of the head. Eyes are not forward-facing predator eyes.
Exactly three short hoofed toes per foot, with a broad middle toe and smaller flanking toes. Four feet have visible clearance, plausible joint transitions and grounded support.

Dense coat conveyed through deliberately faceted body volume, a restrained darker mane/withers region and sparse low-profile fur edge breaks; no thousands of hairs, isolated porcupine cones, fur-covered eyes, or noisy random triangles.
Short tapered tail near the rump, not a long modern-rhino whip. Two-horn/woolly/low-long-trunk combination distinguishes this asset structurally from other rhinoceroses, not by size or palette alone.
frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet grounded quadrupedal stance, head carried low, mouth closed, subtle longitudinal leg staggering to expose all four feet. No extreme action or snow-shoveling claim.

scale.status: Modeling targets, not exact specimen measurements. Published adult females support a roughly 3.2–3.6 m head-body length and 1.45–1.65 m withers height. The selected horns synthesize adult examples rather than replicate the shorter horns of MM 7938.

scientific_limits.en: Body proportions are approximate adult reconstruction targets guided by Kolyma and Starunia measurements, not a cast of one specimen. Horn shape varies and preservation can alter it: the nasal horn has a substantial oval base, not the extremely narrow attachment implied by some older reconstructions. Fur volume, living color, muscle contours, posture and full horn curvature are artistic choices. No sex, exact age, paleocoexistence or current conservation status is asserted.
scientific_limits.zh: 体比例是参考科雷马与斯塔鲁尼亚测量数据的成体复原目标，非单一标本翻模。角形有个体差异且可受保存过程改变：鼻角采用厚实椭圆基部，不照搬部分旧复原中极窄的附着基部。毛量、活体颜色、肌肉轮廓、姿势与完整角弯度为美术选择。不声称性别、准确年龄、同域共生关系或现生保护状态。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original whole-adult woolly rhinoceros reconstruction synthesizing named fossil and permafrost evidence. It is not a scan, an exact individual restoration, or a behavioral demonstration.

view_plan.additional_views: Only if a concrete unresolved issue requires one, with a recorded reason.
view_plan.preview: Exact same bytes as perspective permitted.
view_plan.website_delivery: No website render compatibility claim at prep. Keep the four diagnostic views. If the actual verified website renderer/config can also serve perspective adequately, document that substitution before rendering; otherwise integration owns necessary website derivatives.

description.en: Embolotherium andrewsi with a broad frontonasal ram and reconstructed enlarged nasal soft tissue, informed by the type skull and AMNH interpretation. The body is a comparative brontothere reconstruction, not an associated skeleton; skin, ears, proportions and scale are illustrative, without weapon-function or vocal-behaviour claims.
description.zh: 雷兽 Embolotherium andrewsi 参考模式头骨与 AMNH 解释，呈现宽大额鼻突及推定膨大的鼻部软组织。躯体为比较解剖复原，非完整关联骨架；皮肤、耳、比例与尺度为示意，不宣称武器功能或发声行为。

art_direction.hair: No detailed shaggy coat; any sparse short mane is an optional original simplification, not a fossil claim
art_direction.pose: Neutral standing, no base, landscape, labels, props or loose objects
art_direction.style: Refined low-poly, deliberate faceted lofts and broad plane changes, organic transitions; not an assembly of untouched spheres
art_direction.textures: None required; do not embed reference imagery

frozen_scientific_scope.budget_rationale: Target 4500–8500 triangles; spend detail on integrated nose/ram silhouette, cheek and jaw planes, foot separation and limb transitions. The hard caps are practical asset budgets, not anatomical targets. Do not reduce the characteristic nasal mass to meet an arbitrary low triangle count.

delivery_profile.early_self_check: 3–4 low-cost clay views before final rendering
delivery_profile.preview: May be byte-identical to perspective; render from exact exported GLB
delivery_profile.website_images: No early 768x432 image. No claim that the diagnostic perspective satisfies the website renderer/camera contract; integration handles only necessary display derivatives.

dimensions.interpretation: Art-directed large brontothere scale; not measurements of AMNH 26001. Nose top can reach about shoulder height or slightly above in the selected neutral pose.

morphology_targets: Build a massive barrel-bodied graviportal quadruped with a short strong neck, broad shoulders, separated stout limbs, small ears, and a tapering tail. No armor plates, elephant trunk, antlers, tusks or rhino keratin horn.

The defining cranial structure is ONE midline frontonasal ram with a transversely broad, blunt upper rim, continuous with the nasal/forehead mass. Frontal view must read as a broad coherent plate/ridge, never two freestanding Megacerops prongs.

Use the AMNH E. andrewsi side diagram to orient the head: mouth is below the anterior ram, orbit behind it, high occiput behind the eye. Do not mistake the tall posterior occiput for the nasal ram. Preserve a concave/saddle-shaped top line between the anterior upturned nasal region and posterior cranium.

In the living model fill the region beneath the ram with a thick reconstructed nasal/snout volume. No open triangular hole under a bare shield. Blend the nose into the muzzle and cheek; use modest, non-tubular nostrils and a short closed mouth seam below.

Keep a deep jaw and small lateral eye positioned behind the nasal base. A restrained skin-covering palette must carry over the nose/ram, without a contrasting bone-colored exposed horn. The broad top rim and nasal side planes must remain legible from front, side and perspective.

Use flattened multi-toed feet rather than round balls or cloven bovine hooves. Four forefoot digits and three hindfoot digits are comparative brontothere reconstruction choices, with small side digits kept subordinate. Maintain clear floor contact and no interpenetrating toe clusters.

A quiet four-foot weight-bearing stance, head carried slightly forward and up, keeps the diagnostic snout visible. Slight fore/hind stagger is allowed for readability, not an action, battle or vocalization pose.
negative_examples: A flat detached shield perched on a normal rhino nose
Open empty space beneath an exposed nasal blade
Skull with exposed teeth used as a living head
Front and hind legs merged into one mass
review_targets: Single broad integrated nasal ram survives front, side, top and perspective views
Deep fleshed head with correct mouth/eye/occiput relation
Independent four-limb weight support and readable feet
No source-only artifacts, reference images or private paths in exported/public files

scientific_limits.en: The skull constrains the broad single frontonasal ram and deep, saddle-shaped head. AMNH interprets the process as supporting an enlarged nose, not simply an exposed combat horn. Nasal soft-tissue outline, nostril details, ears, hair, skin, coloration, body proportions, and posture remain reconstruction choices. The type skull has distortion and restoration; do not copy every fossil asymmetry. Body size is an approximate presentation scale, not a specimen measurement. No claim about sex, weapon function, vocal behavior, exact locality, or a complete associated skeleton.
scientific_limits.zh: 头骨限定单一宽大额鼻撞槌状突起及深而鞍状的头部；AMNH 将其解释为支撑膨大的鼻部，不应只做成外露战斗角。鼻部软组织轮廓、鼻孔细节、耳、毛、皮肤、颜色、身体比例和姿势仍属复原选择。模式头骨存在变形及修复，不照搬全部不对称。体型数值是近似展示尺度，并非标本实测；不宣称性别、武器功能、发声行为、精确产地或完整关联骨架。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original stylized whole-animal reconstruction of an adult Embolotherium andrewsi, anchored to the AMNH 26001 type skull and AMNH scientific head reconstruction. The body is a comparative brontothere reconstruction, not a complete associated skeleton or scanned specimen. Static neutral standing candidate only.

description.en: American mastodon, Mammut americanum, with a low elongated head, stocky body and gently upcurved upper tusks, informed by several museum skeletons. Soft tissues, coat and scale are illustrative. Lower tusks are omitted for this adult interpretation, not declared absent throughout the species; diagnostic molars are not exposed.
description.zh: 美洲乳齿象 Mammut americanum 综合多具博物馆骨架，呈现低长头部、粗壮躯体及平缓上弯的上颌长牙。软组织、毛被与尺度为示意。本成体复原不显示下颌长牙，不代表全物种均无此结构；鉴别性臼齿未外露。

acceptance_obligations: Inspect actual exported GLB pixels for all named morphology and craft criteria; names and numeric checks alone are insufficient.
Bind source geometry/export checks, official Khronos validator and exact GLB parse/reimport evidence to final bytes.
Run two isolated deterministic rebuilds and demonstrate semantic geometry/material equivalence with all relative dependencies declared.
Fresh independent visual/factual/specification review must bind actual maker/reviewer identities and hashes. Maker leaves qa/decision.json PENDING.
GPU, populated scene, user acceptance and deployment remain UNKNOWN without their own evidence. Prep readiness and local candidate acceptance do not authorize publication.

art_direction.construction: Use intentional lofted cross sections rather than visible assembled balls and cylinders. Keep the head, neck and shoulders integrated; use smooth decreasing tusk/trunk sections with enough bends to avoid mechanical elbows.
art_direction.ears: Modest rounded lateral ears are artistic soft-tissue choices. Do not enlarge into African-elephant sails or claim precise preserved ear anatomy.
excluded_details: copied museum surface colors or textures
plinth, poles, labels or scenery inside export
art_direction.negative_space: Trunk must separate from both tusks, chest and forefeet. Four legs and tusk roots should remain readable across the standard views; no deep cut seams, hovering feet, detached ears or tusks crossing through the face.
art_direction.tail: Short tapering elephant-like tail with a restrained terminal tuft as an artistic choice; no long feline tail.

frozen_scientific_scope.geometry_budget_rationale: Practical ceilings, not targets. Aim for approximately 4500–8000 emitted triangles. Spend geometry on a low elongated head, coherent shoulder/hip transitions, four separated weight-bearing legs, tapered trunk and continuously curving paired tusks; do not waste it on hair strands or a hidden skeleton.

morphology.basis: Current skeletal images and museum comparative description, with original soft-tissue padding.
morphology.obligation: Keep a forward-elongated head with a relatively broad, low cranial roof and restrained forehead. The face must not have the tall domed, front-to-back compressed mammoth profile. Build a coherent trunk root between and above the tusk roots, not a tube glued below the jaw.

morphology.basis: Inspected modern mounts show substantial upcurvature; comparative text means less twisted than mammoth tusks. Do not copy exaggerated historical replacements.
morphology.obligation: Two thick-rooted tapered upper tusks emerge separately, extend forward and sweep upward in a broad gentle arc. Preserve left/right space around the trunk and visible curved tips; avoid both dead-straight spears and tight inward spiral loops. The inventory term relatively straight is comparative, not literal.

morphology.basis: Skeletal proportions and museum comparison; the fleshed dorsal contour remains interpretive.
morphology.obligation: Deep broad barrel-like torso, robust weight-bearing legs and a long gently rounded back. Shoulders may be modestly higher than the rump, but no exaggerated tall mammoth shoulder hump or steep continuously falling topline. Avoid a perfectly flat plank spine.

morphology.basis: Museum description of broad feet, interpreted as fleshed limbs rather than copied skeletal digits.
morphology.obligation: Four broad rounded feet have credible flattened contact patches. Keep legs robust and separated, with continuous shoulder and hip transitions. Subtle toenails are optional; no exposed splayed skeleton toes on a living reconstruction.

morphology.basis: Combined silhouette requirement, not a claim that this alone proves species-level diagnosis.
morphology.obligation: At thumbnail scale the low long head, deep stocky torso, subdued dorsal slope and non-spiralling upcurved tusks must read together. Do not make a woolly mammoth by only changing the label, color or scale.

original_inventory_identity.selection: Retain the original Mammut entry and its low-head/deep-body/tusk distinction. Species is narrowed to Mammut americanum using named museum evidence, not a switch to Mammuthus or Mammut pacificus.

pose.description: Calm grounded four-foot stance, slightly staggered far legs for readability, long head carried forward at or below shoulder level, relaxed hanging trunk with a modest inward-curved tip, short tail clear of hindfeet. Tusks point forward then curve upward and modestly outward. No rearing, charge, elevated trunk trumpet pose or museum supports.
pose.interpretation: Original stable exhibit pose, not a demonstrated gait or behavior.
pose.mouth: Closed; no exposed molars or speculative dental reconstruction.

runtime_profile.portability: No external texture or buffer dependencies. Maker records observed Blender, exporter and consuming Three.js versions.

scale.basis: Original display proportions. Shoulder height lies within the museum-reported typical 8–10 ft range; all other target dimensions are artistic, not measured from perspective photographs. Preserve real-world scale and do not normalize to a unit cube.

scientific_limits.en: Museum mounts contain restored parts and interpretive poses; historic exaggerated tusks are excluded. Skin, coat color and length, ears, trunk shape, tail and body padding are artistic interpretations. Lower tusks vary in Mammut americanum and are omitted for this late-Pleistocene adult interpretation, not claimed absent in the species or in every reference specimen. Dimensions are illustrative, not measurements of Warren or Fred. The closed mouth does not expose diagnostic molars; species identification rests on the reference context and combined silhouette rather than one external feature.
scientific_limits.zh: 博物馆骨架含修复部件及解释性姿态；历史展示中夸大的长牙不作为依据。皮肤、毛色与毛长、耳、象鼻、尾和躯体软组织均为美术解释。美洲乳齿象下颌长牙存在个体差异，本晚更新世成年复原选择不显示下颌长牙，不代表全物种或全部参考标本均无此结构。尺寸为示意值，并非 Warren 或 Fred 的实测值。闭口模型不展示鉴别性臼齿，物种范围依靠参考背景与组合轮廓，而非单一外形特征。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original static refined-low-poly living reconstruction of an adult Mammut americanum. The named Warren mastodon at AMNH and Fred (Buesching mastodon) at the Indiana State Museum are skeletal comparison anchors; the NHM Hintze Hall mount is supplementary. This is a species-informed composite interpretation, not a scan, fossil replica, or reconstruction of a single measured individual.

surface_profile.materials: Original restrained dark umber/taupe body, subtly lighter underside and inner ear, muted ivory tusks, dark eyes/mouth seam and subdued toenails. Matte portable Principled/glTF materials; no reference pixels copied.
surface_profile.name: palette-only
surface_profile.normal_style: Deliberate broad faceted or mixed planes, soft integrated transitions. Suggest a short/moderate coat through contour and color only; no hair cards, strands or unverified long shag blanket.

anatomical_anchors: Warren mastodon, American Museum of Natural History, Newburgh, New York specimen
Fred / Buesching mastodon, Indiana State Museum
Modern American mastodon mount in Hintze Hall, Natural History Museum, London; restored historical assemblage, not treated as a single measured individual
taxon.geographic_context: North America, with eastern North American named museum specimens used as anchors
taxon.individual_scope: Adult interpretation. No exact sex, body mass, exact fossil age or individual identity is asserted.

view_plan.extra_views: None by default; add a local view only for a specific unresolved issue.
view_plan.final_source: Clean import of exact delivered GLB. Perspective and preview may reuse identical bytes.
view_plan.greybox_note: Inspect 3–4 cheap private clay/silhouette views before final renders. Resolve head height, back slope and tusk/trunk separation first.
view_plan.website_reuse: Website renderer/camera configuration has not been verified during prep. Keep canonical QA directions, do not claim website compatibility, and do not produce 768x432 derivatives here.

description.en: Thylacoleo carnifex, the marsupial lion, in a neutral whole-body stance based on composite fossil anatomy. Soft tissues, coat, ears, colour and size are interpretive; the missing hind-foot hallux tip is conservatively completed. Climbing and tail-bracing remain functional hypotheses, not observed behaviour or a depicted hunting event.
description.zh: 袋狮 Thylacoleo carnifex 综合化石解剖作中性站姿全身复原。软组织、毛被、耳、颜色及尺寸为解释性补配；缺失的后足拇趾末端作保守补全。攀爬与尾支撑仍属功能推断，不代表已观察行为或特定捕猎事件。

art_direction.budget_rationale: Target roughly 6500-11000 triangles; 16000 is a practical ceiling for digit/claw readability and shoulder flow, not a fill target. The 48-primitive ceiling allows editable semantic groups; merge compatible export surfaces where useful without losing editability.
art_direction.construction: Continuous profile lofts for torso/neck/tail and a deliberately shaped broad head. Use section transitions at shoulders, haunches, elbows and wrists. Primitive starting meshes may be heavily reshaped but untouched ellipsoids/cylinders may not constitute the animal.
geometry_priority: Four grounded paws and limb separation
art_direction.surface: Controlled, unevenly spaced facets along designed anatomical planes; primarily matte earth colors with a quieter belly region. No stripes, spots, wet/plastic skin or glossy oversized cartoon eyes.

frozen_scientific_scope.classification: Mammalia, Marsupialia, Diprotodontia, Thylacoleonidae; not a felid.

diagnostic_targets.target: Short, wide, deep cheek region and blunt muzzle; inset eyes and a continuous head-neck transition. No doglike long snout, felid saber canines or lion mane.
Robust braced chest and powerful forearms, with anatomical elbow/wrist transitions rather than exposed sphere joints. Four limbs and belly clearance remain readable.
Each forepaw has four smaller fingers plus the separate medial thumb bearing one enlarged curved claw. Thumb claws must be visibly larger, not claws on the outer wrist or on every digit.
Relatively firm lower back and muscular tapering tail; no long thin feline whip, bushy tuft or repeated beads.
Hindfeet use a low plantigrade pad, slender digits II-V with II/III paired closely, and a small divergent medial hallux restored bluntly. Do not copy the forepaw thumb-claw onto the hindfeet.
Nearly closed mouth, optionally parted slightly to reveal restrained incisors; avoid an invented complete dental display. Short coat and rounded ears remain understated artistic inferences.

frozen_scientific_scope.pose: Quiet, low-headed, weight-bearing quadrupedal stance with slight fore-aft paw staggering. Hind heels are lowered. Tail extends back with a thick stable base, restrained distal descent and no tight curl. No tree, rock, prey, scene props, mane or display pedestal.

scale.status: Illustrative adult-size design targets, not measurements of a particular fossil
scale.tolerance: Approximately 10 percent around artistic dimensions if needed for coherent anatomy; record any intentional change.

scientific_limits.en: Fossil anatomy is separated from inferred soft tissue, coat, color, ear shape and pose. The pedal hallux tip is missing in the cited specimens; a small blunt reconstruction is inferred, not observed. Climbing and tail-bracing are functional hypotheses, not witnessed behavior. This asset shows a neutral stance, not a claimed hunting event. Published museum size summaries and reconstructed skeletal proportions do not define an exact same-individual scale.
scientific_limits.zh: 化石解剖与软组织、毛被、颜色、耳形及姿态推定分开。所引足部标本缺少后足拇趾末端，小钝趾为保守补全而非直接观察。攀爬及尾支撑为功能推断，并非已观察行为。本件采用中性站姿，不复现特定捕猎事件。博物馆尺寸概述与复原骨架比例不能视为同一个体的精确尺寸。

frozen_scientific_scope.scope: Original, whole-organism, refined low-poly reconstruction of the Pleistocene Australian marsupial Thylacoleo carnifex. Composite anatomical interpretation, not a fossil scan or one measured individual.

texture_policy.reason: Silhouette and tailored faceting carry this model; no copied photo texture or fur microgeometry.

view_plan.final: Four exact-delivered-GLB views; perspective and preview may be identical bytes. Only add a local detail if a specific claw or contact issue is invisible in these views.
view_plan.website: No additional site images in prep or maker by default. Actual website renderer/config compatibility must be verified before claiming reuse; no guessed camera substitution.

reconstruction_notes: Skull lateral depth and tooth-size contrast informed by BMNH41212; BMNH43486 separate mandible; R1034 separate partial postcranium. BSP1994I51 excluded.
Three free manual digits plus one elongate wing-support digit on each forelimb are conservative pterosaur reconstruction, not a digit census from supplied slab.
Five pedal digits per foot: four shorter forward grasping toes and one longer posterolateral fifth; explicit artistic restoration independently reviewable, not measured from R1034.

Pose, proportions, skull breadth, living skin, eye and nostril placement, tail curve/length, membrane, palette and display dimensions are artistic. No preserved pigment, complete tail or habitual behavior claim.
No crest, feathers, naked fenestra holes, detached avian wing pair, ornamental tail vane, platform or copied fossil displacement.
